name: Black Seed Oil
summary: Black Seed Oil carries a Avoid / Insufficient Evidence rating. Recorded activity centres on inflammatory signaling modulation, oxidative stress modulation and metabolic regulation, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include pregnancy due to insufficient safety data and discontinue before scheduled surgery due to bleeding risk.
description: Black Seed Oil compound profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
safetyNotes: GI upset and possible hypoglycemia; caution antidiabetic drugs and pregnancy.
contraindications: anticoagulant or antiplatelet medication due to enhanced bleeding risk
antihypertensive medication due to additive blood pressure lowering effect
immunosuppressant medication due to reduced effectiveness from immune-stimulating activity
dextromethorphan or other CYP2D6 or CYP3A4 substrate medications due to documented enzyme inhibition shown in a human trial at 5 grams per day
pregnancy due to insufficient safety data
discontinue before scheduled surgery due to bleeding risk
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (insufficient evidence) and evidence tier (limited evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
